mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (id) VALUES (CAST(#{userId} AS uuid)) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO user_concepts (user_id, concept_id, correct, total, updated_at) SELECT CAST(#{userId} AS uuid), c.id, CASE WHEN #{correct} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 1, now() FROM concepts c WHERE c.id = ANY(#{conceptIds, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, concept_id) DO UPDATE SET correct = user_concepts.correct + EXCLUDED.correct, total = user_concepts.total + 1, updated_at = now()
